messages:
Aisha (PM): Quick follow-up after the design review - proposing a compact welcome surface for new accounts. Thoughts?
Liam (Design): Love simplifying. Question: do we keep the checklist visible or collapse into a 'Start tour' CTA? :thinking_face:
Ravi (Frontend): Collapsing helps mobile, but checklist gives discoverability. Implementation-wise, we can animate expand/collapse without reflow issues.
Marta (Research): In usability tests, people skipped big banners. The checklist increased completion by ~18% vs plain CTA. But CTA still needed for fast users.
Liam (Design): OK so maybe hybrid: compact summary (3 bullets) + 'View checklist' link. Also need copy tweak for step names.
Aisha (PM): I like hybrid. For copy: 'Connect a project', 'Try a sample prompt', 'Invite teammates' — any shorter variants?
Ravi (Frontend): Shorten to verbs: 'Connect project', 'Run sample', 'Invite team' — fits 2-line layout.
Liam (Design): Accessibility nit: color contrast for the "Run sample" pill is 3.8:1 currently. Need 4.5:1 for AA on normal text. Can we darken it 10%?
Ravi (Frontend): Yep. I'll adjust tokens in theme vars. Also add focus outline for keyboard nav.
Marta (Research): Also add aria-live region when the checklist collapses/expands so screen reader users get context.
Devex Bot: deploy-preview/boarding-surface-compact v2 is ready: https://deploys/redwood/pr-4521 :rocket:
Aisha (PM): Nice. Dev: can we pre-select a sample project in the quickstart banner? Product wants to surface 'Customer Support Bot' as default.
Ravi (Frontend): We can. Need API change to include sampleProjectId in /users/first-run. I'll stub it.
Liam (Design): Copy tweak for the banner header: current 'Get started with Redwood' -> 'Start your first project' (more action-oriented).
Marta (Research): Microcopy for sample project card needs context about costs. Add small 'free demo' label and tooltip: 'No GPU credits consumed.'
Aisha (PM): Good call. Also A11y: buttons should have aria-labels when icon-only (close X on banner).
Ravi (Frontend): Will add aria-label="dismiss onboarding banner".
Liam (Design): One more layout debate: vertical stepper vs horizontal progress pills. Horizontal saves vertical space in the dashboard header.
Marta (Research): Users preferred horizontal for short flows. If we have 3 steps, pills are clear.
Aisha (PM): OK final decisions: hybrid checklist (3 bullets + 'View checklist'), compact quickstart banner with default sample, contrast fix + focus outlines, aria-live on collapse, aria-labels on icon buttons, microcopy updates. I'll file a ticket with ACs.
Ravi (Frontend): I'll open the PR and link it here when ready.
Aisha (PM): Thanks! :raised_hands:
